hunks.baseline: The magical power that had erased even the radioactive fallout drifted about as a blackish fog, and the walls arranged in the shape of a pentagram towered like mountains.
hunks.sol: The magical power that had erased even the radioactive fallout drifted as a blackish fog, and the walls, arranged in the shape of a pentagram, towered like mountains.

hunks.baseline: In a moment split into ever smaller fractions, a gigantic black dragon opened its jaws, and an explosion of magical power burst forth.
hunks.sol: In an instant split into ever smaller fractions, the gigantic black dragon opened its jaws, and an explosion of magical power burst forth.

hunks.baseline: Piercing the clouds, cleaving the sky in two, as if it meant to reach the distant, faraway moon.
hunks.sol: It pierced the clouds and cleaved the sky in two, as if it meant to reach the distant moon.

hunks.baseline: I barely managed to suppress the groan rising between my lips.
hunks.sol: I barely managed to suppress the groan rising in my throat.

hunks.baseline: It was only a video, but the tremor and atmosphere within it were enough to awaken my instincts.
hunks.sol: It was only a video, but the tremor and the atmosphere it conveyed were enough to awaken my instincts.

hunks.baseline: My heart was suddenly pounding wildly, the fine hairs all over my body stood on end, and the blood in my veins felt cold as ice. They bore witness and passed judgment.
hunks.sol: My heart was suddenly pounding wildly. The fine hairs all over my body stood on end, and the blood in my veins felt cold as ice. Together, they bore witness and passed judgment.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps it was the difference in their very species, combined with the weight of power amassed over a long, long time.
hunks.sol: Perhaps it was the difference in their species itself, combined with the weight of power amassed over countless years.

hunks.baseline: *So this is a dragon.*
hunks.sol: *So this is a Dragon.*

hunks.baseline: The terrifying power felt more real than a mere hologram. I couldn’t help but shudder—and neither could anyone else in the conference room.
hunks.sol: Its terrifying power felt more real than a mere hologram. I couldn’t help but shudder—and neither could anyone else in the conference room.

hunks.baseline: With a deafening roar, countless dark clouds surged in, covering the moon and stars. Then, like ink spreading through water, they took over the skies above Moscow for thousands of kilometers.
hunks.sol: With a roar like the sky splitting apart, countless dark clouds surged in and covered the moon and stars. Then, like paint spreading across a canvas, they claimed thousands of kilometers of sky above Moscow.

hunks.baseline: And the place where the abyss had settled resembled another world beyond our dimension, one humanity had only ever imagined.
hunks.sol: And where the abyss had settled, the sky resembled another world beyond our dimension, one humanity had only ever imagined.

hunks.baseline: Would this be what it felt like if lightning struck the crown of your head?
hunks.sol: Was this what it felt like to be struck by lightning right on the crown of the head?

hunks.baseline: The air had frozen. Those who understood the meaning hidden in the glitching holographic footage could only stare, eyes wide, unable to speak.
hunks.sol: The air had frozen. Those who grasped the meaning of the static-riddled holographic footage could only stare, eyes wide, unable to speak.

hunks.baseline: They clenched their fists until they nearly broke them, gritted their teeth, and stared with bloodshot eyes.
hunks.sol: They clenched their fists as if they might crush them, gritted their teeth, and watched with bloodshot eyes.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, they heard it.
hunks.sol: At the same time, we heard it.

hunks.baseline: The black dragon stood tall atop the highest spire, crying out toward the pitch-black sky.
hunks.sol: The cry of the black dragon standing atop the highest spire, calling out to the pitch-black sky.

hunks.baseline: It was more than a sound; it reached the level of will. No one here—or anywhere in the world—could understand the mysterious language.
hunks.sol: It was more than a sound; it reached directly into the mind. No one here—or anywhere else in the world—could understand the mysterious language.

hunks.baseline: “……Answer the call.”
hunks.sol: “…Answer the call.”

hunks.baseline: The words slipped out as a groan.
hunks.sol: The words escaped me in a groan.

hunks.baseline: The deafening roar that had shaken heaven and earth faded, and so did the wind that had been raging like mad.
hunks.sol: The roar that had shaken heaven and earth vanished, along with the wind that had been raging like mad.

hunks.baseline: All noise vanished in an instant. The world, with even the air seemingly still, looked impossibly peaceful.
hunks.sol: All noise disappeared in an instant. With even the air seemingly still, the world looked impossibly peaceful.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds, thousands of Wyverns and Drakes, their yellow eyes flashing, poured toward the ground, along with countless monsters clinging to their enormous bodies and wings.
hunks.sol: Hundreds, thousands of Wyverns and Drakes poured toward the ground, their bright yellow eyes flashing. Countless monsters clung to their enormous bodies and wings.

hunks.baseline: When the Liches cast their spells in unison, the giant monsters plunging down like meteors from the distant sky drifted gently to the ground like feathers. Death Knights raced through the air on ghostly horses and led their legions to fill the vast ruins.
hunks.sol: When the Liches cast their spells in unison, the giant monsters plunging from high above like meteors drifted gently to the ground like feathers. Death Knights raced through the air on ghostly horses and led their legions across the vast ruins.

hunks.baseline: They roared with cries that mingled joy and bloodlust.
hunks.sol: They roared with joy and bloodlust.

hunks.baseline: A display of reverence for the one being who had brought them into this world.
hunks.sol: All in reverence for the one being who had brought them into this world.

hunks.baseline: —In the name of my soul and my name, I, Morgoth, master of the Silver Mountains and Archduke of the Demon Realm, swear to you humans:
hunks.sol: —On my soul and in my name, I, Morgoth, master of the Silver Mountains and Archduke of the Demon Realm, swear this to you humans:

hunks.baseline: The moment my eyes met the monster’s through the hologram, I suddenly realized something.
hunks.sol: The moment my eyes met the monster’s through the hologram, I realized something.

hunks.baseline: —If you resist, I promise you the most horrific end you have ever seen. If you surrender, I promise complete peace and survival.
hunks.sol: —If you resist, I promise you an end more horrific than any you have ever seen. If you surrender, I promise complete peace and survival.

hunks.baseline: There was still one thing I hadn’t predicted.
hunks.sol: I hadn’t seen everything coming.

hunks.baseline: —Just two humans—a paltry price next to the lives of billions of your kind.
hunks.sol: —A mere two humans, worth nothing beside the lives of billions of your kind.

hunks.baseline: —Bring them to their knees before me.
hunks.sol: —Make them kneel before me.

hunks.baseline: The dragon’s eyes, like swirling abysses of obsidian, flashed.
hunks.sol: The dragon’s eyes flashed, black as obsidian and swirling like the abyss.

hunks.baseline: Humanity was already recovering its stability faster than the various international organizations had predicted—or perhaps even faster than that.
hunks.sol: Humanity was already regaining its composure far faster than the international organizations had predicted—perhaps faster than even they could have imagined.

hunks.baseline: The footage of Moscow’s destruction was enough to plunge everyone into an abyss of shock and fear. Yet a single fact announced less than a few hours later was like a ladder of salvation to them.
hunks.sol: The footage of Moscow being wiped out had plunged everyone into shock and fear. Yet a single fact announced only hours later offered them a way out of despair.

hunks.baseline: └ I’m genuinely worried about you, so you should delete this stupid comment before the FBI shows up in about thirty minutes, breaks down your door, and kicks your fat ass.
hunks.sol: └ I’m genuinely worried about you, so delete that stupid comment before the FBI shows up in about thirty minutes, breaks down your door, and kicks your fat ass.

hunks.baseline: └ Oh, our Korean friend is here. He’s so worked up he even made a typo. That guy won’t be able to play games properly anymore. Koreans never miss the target once they’ve locked on.
hunks.sol: └ Oh, our Korean friend is here. He’s so worked up he even made a typo. That guy won’t be able to play games properly anymore. Koreans never miss a target once they’ve locked on.

hunks.baseline: Ever since Morgoth appeared, the internet message boards had been frozen, not even managing the most ordinary joke. Now they were full of life again.
hunks.sol: Ever since Morgoth appeared, the internet message boards had been frozen, without so much as an ordinary joke. Now they were lively again.

hunks.baseline: They all knew who *he* was, even without anyone saying his name.
hunks.sol: Everyone knew who *he* was, even without anyone saying his name.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung had become a savior of a new age, one who needed no embellishment.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung had become the savior of a new age, one who needed no grand description.

hunks.baseline: Who else could fill Cheon Taemin’s place while he lay unconscious—and make that place his own—then clean up disasters around the world and save countless lives?
hunks.sol: He had done more than fill the place left by the unconscious Cheon Taemin. He had made it his own, dealt with disasters across the world, and saved countless lives. Who could take his place?

hunks.baseline: But less than a day later, humanity received a warning from Morgoth that reached across the world, including the Pentagon. Then they understood all too well:
hunks.sol: But less than a day later, a warning reached the Pentagon and the rest of the world. Humanity understood all too well:

hunks.baseline: How futile the hope they had briefly felt was, faced with that great army that had invaded Earth through a Gate unlike any before it.
hunks.sol: How futile their brief hope was before the vast army that had invaded Earth through a Gate unlike any before it.

hunks.baseline: —Bring them to their knees before me.
hunks.sol: —Make them kneel before me.

hunks.baseline: How far the desire to survive could make people stoop.
hunks.sol: How cowardly the desire to survive could make them.

hunks.baseline: Some were enraged, but others kept their mouths firmly shut.
hunks.sol: Some were enraged, while others kept their mouths firmly shut.

hunks.baseline: The former called for a fight to the death; the latter hid their voices to avoid criticism.
hunks.sol: The former called for a fight to the death; the latter hid their opinions to avoid criticism.

hunks.baseline: But half a day later—
hunks.sol: But another half day passed.

hunks.baseline: At last, people saw footage of the monster army that had seized all of Russia and was advancing in every direction. They had no choice but to fall silent.
hunks.sol: People saw footage of the monster army that had seized all of Russia and was advancing in every direction. At last, they all fell silent.

hunks.baseline: All thinking the same thing, though they couldn’t bring themselves to say it to anyone.
hunks.sol: Each of them thinking the same thing, though none could bring themselves to say it aloud.
